data.title: Two Lenses on the Chip War
data.subtitle: How different frameworks explain US-China semiconductor competition
data.subtitleCn: 不同框架如何解释美中芯片竞争

frameworkA.name: Realism

tenets.text: States are primary actors in world politics
Power is zero-sum—gains for one nation are losses for another
Security drives policy more than economics
Cooperation is fragile without enforcement mechanisms

frameworkA.verdict: Explains escalation logic and strategic decoupling
frameworkA.verdictCn: 解释升级逻辑和战略脱钩

frameworkB.name: Liberalism

tenets.text: Trade creates mutual dependence and incentive for cooperation
Democratic states rarely fight each other
Norms and law shape outcomes as much as material interests

frameworkB.verdictCn: 更好地解释2020年前的相互依赖

data.verdictLabel: Which framework fits better? The evidence is mixed.
data.verdictLabelCn: 哪个框架更合适?证据是混合的。
